title: 5 Reasons People LOVE Living in Killeen Texas in 2026!
description:

Are you thinking about moving to Killeen, Texas or relocating somewhere in Central Texas? In this video, I’m sharing the top 5 reasons why so many people are choosing to call Killeen home in 2026. Whether you're PCS-ing to Fort Cavazos, moving from out of state, retiring, or simply looking for a more affordable place to live in Texas, this video will give you a real look at the pros of living in Killeen and what makes this area so appealing.
